name: Vertical Analyst Note (master template, from Vertical_Analyst_Note_10.docx)

required_production_fields: access_level (Public / Limited / Client only, exact wording from the template)
landing_page (chart title + caption <= 30 words + header + body)

required: 3-5 lead_bullets in the Hemingway-analyst register: the BOLD lead is a short declarative takeaway carrying its metric; support sentences chain naturally behind it
NO rhetorical hooks or aphorisms as leads; the number and its consequence, plainly
the first bullet is the single sharpest signal
forward-looking bullets carry lexicon words with parenthetical odds; confidence stated separately where it matters
no bullet without a number; every figure carries its date

sections.title_hint: 2-4 analytical sections, h2, titled as claims
required: one story across the sections: each section closes by raising the question the next answers (the handoff), and the verdict resolves the story the note opened
each section earns one second-level insight, with its evidence in the same section
three-beat discipline per section: fact -> mechanism -> implication
every chart referenced from the text it supports
chart captions 30 words or fewer (template rule; build warns past it)
citations are [n] endnote markers tied to References; dates inline only where analytically relevant
charts: house factory; count declared on the meta sheet must match

required: REQUIRED when the note makes forward-looking judgments: the lexicon box via engine.compose.lexicon_blocks(), placed after the last analytical section
every parenthetical probability logged in the validation log with date and resolution criterion
numbered source list rendered from report.json 'references'
every load-bearing claim in the body traceable to an entry
links included where public URLs exist
